subject: Help with placing y axis on the right side

messages.author: 9e6bd339af256a4a
messages.subject: Help with placing y axis on the right side
parts:
Hey ggplot community,
I'm trying to make some graphs with the y-axis on the right side (not dual axis).
I found in the link below that  adding scale_y_continuous (position = "right") to my code put the axis in the right as I want.

https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/cowplot/vignettes/axis_position.html

 But the problem as shown in the attached graph, the title of y axis is reading from top to bottom. I added theme(axis.title.y = element_text(vjust=0.5, angle = -270))  to my code but it didn't work either.
Here is part of the code I'm using
p1 <- ggplot(tip1, aes(DAT, Photo, group=Temp)) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype = Temp), size = 1.5) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = Temp), size = 3, fill = "white") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=Photo-se, ymax=Photo+se),
                width=.2) 
p1 +scale_y_continuous(position = "right") +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(vjust=0.5, angle = -270)) 

Any help to fix this is greatly appreciated
Best regards,

messages.author: 8d49e0da2f37b046
messages.subject: Re: Help with placing y axis on the right side
parts:
Try changing axis.title.y to axis.title.y.right inside your theme layer.

Best,

Nicole Meyer
